outcome: exclusive breastfeeding for the first 6 months
cohort: 3541 Bangladeshi mothers with at least one child aged 6 months or younger
finding: The prevalence of exclusive breastfeeding for the first 6 months was 35.90%, and several modifiable factors were associated with exclusive breastfeeding.
mod_finding: Mothers who had non-cesarean deliveries were more likely to exclusively breastfeed.
